# Frida Gadget 17.15.3, Windows x86-64

The unmodified release archive is bundled for offline installation:

`frida-gadget-17.15.3-windows-x86_64.dll.xz`

Upstream release:
https://github.com/frida/frida/releases/tag/17.15.3

SHA-256 archive:
`b566d70189b6d551ad8f4e0bea24de08a3d4c0f559bb35b2bdb67d45182240c2`

SHA-256 decompressed DLL:
`6fca4007b2284c765a6c15c967a741f536b5865bf83867326a54029a3b752748`

The launcher checks both digests before loading. It never downloads executable
code at runtime. The archive was copied from the previously verified local
release cache; no machine state accompanies it.

included notices), and `COPYING.LIB` (GNU Library GPL v2 referenced by the
wxWindows Library Licence). Sources:
